why: Headline, standfirst, key points and both covers are built on the 9:35 am intraday low (Nifty 24,388.05, down 148.55; Sensex 79,016.05, down 0.37%), but the market has since recovered. The notes' own sources show it: the Business Standard live blog at 10:00 am has the Sensex at 79,807.96 and the Nifty at 24,623.75, up 87.90 (the notes threw that entry out as 'inconsistent'), and Trade Brains around 10:00 am has the Sensex up 0.19% at 79,462.70 and the Nifty down only 0.05% at 24,524.50. So 'Sensex, Nifty slip' is out of date at publish time (rule 9b). Smaller point: the 'Nasdaq fell 5.52%' figure is not in any source on this story; IANS says 5.6% (5.52% comes from our Wall Street story).
